stem: Why did Alexander Hamilton think a national bank would strengthen the central government?

options.label: A
options.text: The bank would help provide stability for the U.S. economy.

options.label: B
options.text: The bank would create a monopoly that would eliminate state banks.

options.label: C
options.text: The bank would encourage foreign competition for manufactured goods.

options.label: D
options.text: The bank would have the power to regulate interstate commerce.
